description:
A media streaming client for Plex


## New features

- Search results can be filtered by media type
- The sidebar is restyled as an M3 Expressive navigation rail

## Playback

- Playback stats show the source audio track and codec during passthrough
- Compressed embedded MKV subtitles render on the ExoPlayer path
- Android MPV no longer shows a blue screen for hardware-decoded HEVC on Nvidia Shield

## Plex

- Artwork is requested at native size instead of server-side upscales

## Jellyfin & Emby

- Items removed from Emby Continue Watching no longer reappear

## Explore & trackers

- The Seerr request action appears on items opened from Discover hubs and search
- AniList and MAL entries set to rewatching stay rewatching when scrobbled

## TV & profiles

- Waking the device mid-video resumes playback instead of a stuck profile picker
- D-pad focus follows the played item when Continue Watching reorders
- Posters and thumbnails load at full resolution on low-end TV hardware

## UI

- Closing context menus no longer scrolls detail pages to the top or resets the season selector

## Desktop

- Quitting hides the window immediately instead of showing teardown

## tvOS

- Dolby Direct Play no longer develops continuous judder
- Adding a server no longer freezes remote input at the username field
- Siri Remote swipe navigation matches the native focus-engine feel

## Linux

- Audio Normalization no longer causes startup audio stutter
- Wayland HDR no longer flickers to SDR every few seconds
